'''Cralliard''', also known as '''Cralliard the Hunter''', was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He was employed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor]] to hunt prisoners in his [[Game Chambers]]. He was armed with a [[Hunting blaster/Legends|hunting blaster]].
